seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Fullerton, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Fullerton, California for 2026: a Winter Market with a train ride, tree lighting, Santa at the Train Museum and a Nutcracker.
lede: Fullerton kicks off Christmas with a City Hall tree lighting and a downtown Winter Market, then adds a Santa morning at its free train museum.
celebrates: Fullerton's holiday season centers on downtown and a few local landmarks. The City of Fullerton hosts an annual tree lighting at City Hall with a classic car show, carolers and Santa. The Fullerton Museum Center runs a free Winter Market in Downtown Fullerton Plaza, with vendors, crafts, Santa photos and a train ride. The Fullerton Arboretum at Cal State Fullerton holds a Family Holiday Stroll, and the Muckenthaler Cultural Center throws a free Holiday Festival with kids' art workshops. Nouveau Chamber Ballet, based in Fullerton, stages a 90 minute Nutcracker for families.
lastyear: Local news reported on Fullerton's holiday kickoff in earlier years. The Fullerton Observer wrote in November 2023 that the Fullerton Museum Center hosted its winter market along with the tree and menorah lighting ceremony in downtown Fullerton on Saturday, December 2, 2023. The Muckenthaler's own program archive lists its Holiday Festival on Sunday, December 18, 2022, from noon to 4 pm with free admission. For 2026 the Winter Market is Saturday, December 5 and the Muckenthaler festival is Sunday, December 13.
facts: The Fullerton Train Museum's own site says it is presented by the SCRPA and that it is open the first and third Saturday of each month from 9 am to noon with free admission. It sits at 200 East Santa Fe Avenue. The museum's site also lists a Railroad Days in Fullerton event, which shows how closely the railroad is tied to the town's identity.
trains: Fullerton has its own train museum. The Fullerton Train Museum at 200 E Santa Fe Ave has free admission, opens the first and third Saturday of each month and lists Santa Claus on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 9 am to noon. Our train museum guide describes seven vintage railcars and a Metrolink locomotive at the Fullerton train station. The Winter Market in Downtown Fullerton Plaza also lists a festive train ride for little ones.
train_links: Free vintage railcars and a Metrolink locomotive at the Fullerton train station, open the first and third Saturday of each month.

kidfact: Fullerton has a real train museum with vintage railcars, and Santa visits it on December 19.
faq: What is the biggest Christmas event in Fullerton?
The Winter Market in Downtown Fullerton Plaza, a free festival with more than 40 vendors, free crafts, photos with Santa and a train ride, according to the Fullerton Museum Center.
Can kids ride a train in Fullerton at Christmas?
The Winter Market lists a festive train ride for little ones, and the Fullerton Train Museum is open for Santa on December 19.
Is the Fullerton Train Museum free?
Yes. The museum's own site says admission is free, and it is open the first and third Saturday of each month from 9 am to noon.
Does Fullerton have a tree lighting?
Yes. The City of Fullerton holds an annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall, with a classic car show, carolers, face painting and food trucks.
Where can we see The Nutcracker in Fullerton?
Nouveau Chamber Ballet performs a 90 minute Nutcracker at the Fullerton College Campus Theatre, 321 E Chapman Ave.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fullerton for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Tree Lighting Ceremony at Fullerton City Hall) through December 20 (Nouveau Chamber Ballet The Nutcracker), with Winter Market at Downtown Fullerton Plaza (December 5), the Winter Market and Family Holiday Stroll at Fullerton Arboretum (December 6) and the Holiday Festival at The Muckenthaler (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fullerton

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Fullerton
  • 3 free events: Winter Market at Downtown Fullerton Plaza, Santa Claus at the Fullerton Train Museum and the Holiday Festival at The Muckenthaler
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the City Hall Tree Lighting (December 4), Winter Market photos with Santa (December 5) and Santa Claus at the Fullerton Train Museum (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Tree Lighting Ceremony at Fullerton City Hall (December 4)
  • Trains: Santa Claus at the Fullerton Train Museum (December 19) and the festive train ride at the Winter Market (December 5)
  • Shows: Nouveau Chamber Ballet The Nutcracker at the Fullerton College Campus Theatre (December 19 and 20)
  • Season: December 4 to December 20
